title: fix(app-shell): three designer inspectors read their words in the designer's locale (objectui#10586)
body:
Part of #10586
Refs #10586 — PR 1 of 2. The card stays open: PR 2 carries `HookDefaultInspector.tsx` and `ActionDefaultInspector.tsx`, which seat 2's live claim on objectui#10585 edits today.

Clause-②: no

The English literals of three designer inspectors move behind the designer catalogue's `t()`, each with an en and a zh row, and en renders byte-identical. No schema, export or accept set moves.

## What changes

| file | locale channel | catalogue rows added (en + zh) | existing rows reused |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `inspectors/DatasetDefaultInspector.tsx` | the host's `locale` prop (`MetadataDefaultInspectorProps.locale`), the channel `ObjectDefaultInspector` and `ReportDefaultInspector` read | `engine.inspector.dataset.*` (88) | `engine.form.add`, `engine.form.searchFields` |
| `inspectors/FlowReferenceField.tsx` (`ReferenceCombobox`, `RecordLookupCell`, `connectorsToOptions`) | `useMetadataLocale()`, already read there for the objectui#10448 flag | `engine.inspector.reference.*` (10) | none |
| `inspectors/ConditionBuilder.tsx` | `useMetadataLocale()`, through the existing `tLocal` | `engine.inspector.condition.*` (15) | none |
| `metadata-admin/i18n.ts` | | the same rows in `ENGINE_STRINGS_EN` and `ENGINE_STRINGS_ZH`; `pnpm check:i18n-drift` reads "0 en value(s) changed (113 key(s) added, 0 removed)" | |

- Sentences that carry a value use `{token}` slots. `tFormat` fills plain values. A file-local `withSlots` fills React nodes (a code span, the emphasised tab name) with the split-and-interleave that `ResourceEditPage` already uses for `engine.edit.readOnlyBanner`. The lookup mechanism is the existing one.
- Plurals: `…One` / `…Other` row pairs, picked by `count === 1`, which is the rule the en code applied. zh carries its single form in both rows.
- Option labels are keyed by the stored value (`KeyedOption`) and resolved at render, so stored values do not move. Deliberately left literal: `≥` / `≤` (symbols), currency codes with their signs, decimal digits.
- `connectorsToOptions(connectors, locale?)`: the optional locale is for the `· declarative` annotation. Without it the answer is en, so `FlowReferenceField.connector.test.ts` is unchanged. `useConnectorListOptions` keys its effect on the `locale` string, a primitive (AGENTS.md rule 10). `DatasetDefaultInspector`'s `tr` is a plain function, and nothing keys on its identity.
- zh wording follows the catalogue's own rows: 数据集 / 维度 / 度量 / 聚合方式 / 显示名 / 货币 / 查找关系. ConditionBuilder's joins 且 / 或 follow the packs' `filterBuilder.and` / `filterBuilder.or`, and its 搭建器 matches `engine.condition.advancedHint`.

## Premise check: the dispatch's mechanism hypotheses, measured

- **H1 (floor census at `e0f8202`).** The floor regex reproduces 32 literals / 0 `t()` for the dataset inspector and 5 / 1 for `FlowReferenceField`. For `ConditionBuilder` my spelling of the regex reads 3 literals, because the two join text nodes, AND and OR, also match. The three files and `i18n.ts` are byte-identical between `e0f8202` and this branch's base `668dd59`. Reading the files end to end gives the full set, which is what the pin lists: 77 rendered strings over the dataset fixtures, 10 for the reference picker and 15 for the condition builder. That includes lower-case option labels, `aria-label` / `title` / `placeholder` values and composed sentences the regex cannot see.
- **H2 confirmed.** The translated siblings import `t` / `tFormat` from `../i18n.js` and key into `engine.inspector.KIND.*` / `engine.form.*`. This PR does the same.
- **H3 falsified.** `engine.inspector.*` / `engine.form.*` rows do not live in the ten packs under `packages/i18n/src/locales/`. They live in the module-local two-locale table `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` (en-US and zh-CN). `packages/i18n/README.md`, section "Scope — the `engine.*` carve-out" (objectui#4662), records that no `engine.*` key exists in any pack, by design. Writing them into the packs would add a second mechanism and contradict that ruling. So every new key goes into both locales that namespace has, en and zh, and `packages/i18n` is untouched. The consequence is the carve-out's accepted price: the other eight shipped locales render these strings in English, like every other `engine.*` string. File-surface consequence: the claim named the packs, and the keys went to `metadata-admin/i18n.ts` instead. When this change was made, no open PR and no pushed claim branch (objectui#10585's included) touched `i18n.ts`.
- **H4.** This table's completeness gate exists, `pnpm check:i18n-designer-parity` (EN/ZH rows and placeholders), and it is green. The pack gates are outside its subject and also green (`packages/i18n/` run below).

## en byte-identical: one-off measurement, not a committed test

A throwaway harness rendered the three inspectors under en-US in 21 fixture states and wrote `document.body.innerHTML` after each. Those states were: dataset bound, unbound, create mode, advanced filter and open popover; every reference kind with a hint, the directory lookup and its manual-entry toggle; the condition builder empty, with rows, with both joins and in raw mode. It ran once on the base sources and once on the fix. Both dumps were 169917 bytes with sha256 `920a835809270db29527d4f0183a7ba518ec48cdcccf4d68c6256de6cab0b7c5`, and `cmp` exited 0. The harness was deleted before the first commit.

## Pin: red on base, green on head

`inspectors/inspectorStrings.i18n-10586.test.tsx` has 10 cases:
- per inspector, a zh case: a sweep asserts that none of the pre-fix strings renders, using exact membership over element text, text nodes, `aria-label`, `title` and `placeholder`; then named zh samples are read back from the catalogue behind a not-the-key / not-the-en-row guard;
- per inspector, an en case: every pre-fix string still renders, word for word;
- a slot case for the dataset format sample;
- three lit controls on text that was already translated, through the same probe: `ObjectDefaultInspector` (the `locale` prop channel), the membership-tier flag and the raw CEL editor's label (the `I18nProvider` channel).

Measurements:
- **Base leg**: the four source files checked out from `668dd59`, the pin from head `30171d2`. Result `Tests 4 failed | 6 passed (10)`, exit 1. The three zh sweeps list the English still rendered: dataset 77 of 77, reference 10 of 10, condition 15 of 15. The slot case read `Sample: `. The 6 passes are the three en cases and the three lit controls, so the probe does see a translation where one exists.
- **Keys-only leg**: `i18n.ts` from head, the three inspectors from `668dd59`, at `86d7ffe`. Result `Tests 4 failed | 6 passed (10)`, exit 1. The catalogue rows alone change nothing on screen.
- **Head**: `Tests 10 passed (10)`, re-run at `ae5c50c`.
- Restore after each leg: `git checkout HEAD --` on the mutated paths, then `git diff HEAD` empty and each path's `git hash-object` equal to its HEAD blob.

## Gates

The branch merged `origin/main` three times: `2803fac`, `4a3d500`, then `f99f9cd`. Final head is `ae5c50c`.

| gate | exit | reading | at |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/`, as 4 path-split runs (`inspectors/`; `previews/` + `external/` + `__tests__/`; the top-level files in two halves) | 0, 0, 0, 0 | 100 + 63 + 72 + 72 = 307 files; 1392 passed (1 skipped) + 733 + 500 + 876 tests | `d656ea6` |
| same: the pin and `previews/` again, after the second merge (which touched `previews/ToolPreview.tsx`) | 0 | 62 files, 712 tests | `50a3991` |
| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/i18n/` | 0 | 71 files, 1178 tests | `d656ea6` |
| readers outside that directory: 2 `studio-design` tests and the `check-i18n-call-site-keys`, `check-i18n-dead-keys` and `vite-dts-explicit-extensions` script tests | 0 | 5 files, 292 tests | `d656ea6` |
| `pnpm turbo run type-check --filter @object-ui/app-shell --filter @object-ui/i18n --concurrency=2` | 0 | 31/31 tasks; both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` ran, and `--listFiles` shows the test project compiles the new test | `ae5c50c` |
| eslint, plain form, on the 5 changed TS files | 0 | `--format json`: 5 files, 0 errors, 20 warnings. The per-file warning counts equal base (0, 7, 3, 10; the new test 0) | `ae5c50c` |
| `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check-changeset-presence` (5 source files of 1 released package, 1 changeset), `check-changeset-no-major` | 0 each | | `ae5c50c` |

- The eslint narrowing is a measurement, not a skip. The population is the changed `.ts` / `.tsx` files, which the config's `**/*.{ts,tsx}` block covers; the JSON output counts 5 files. `eslint.config.js` configures no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`), so this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict.
- `check:changeset-claims` reports 3 pending bodies that name `i18n.ts`: `6310-designer-formula-key-retired`, `7125-dashboard-empty-state-keys-retired` and `8632-malformed-picklist-option-loud`. I read each paragraph, and all three still hold: the first two are about keys this PR does not touch, and the third restates the carve-out this PR follows.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:eager-locale-catalogues` exited 2 with PREREQUISITE NOT MET, because it reads a built `apps/console` bundle; the eager-closure budget needs the same build. `performance-budget.yml` runs both. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` and the full `pnpm test` shards belong to CI.

Round 2 (`89852f7`): merged `origin/main` `9d89c6f` (conflict-free; the incoming diff is `plugin-gantt` and its changeset only). At `89852f7`, through `os-verify-lock`: the pin `inspectorStrings.i18n-10586.test.tsx` `Tests 10 passed (10)`, exit 0; `check:i18n-designer-parity` exit 0; `pnpm turbo run type-check --filter @object-ui/app-shell` 30/30 tasks, exit 0 (app-shell cache miss, so it executed).

## Acceptance notes

- `engine.condition.celLabel` / `engine.condition.advancedHint` stay under `engine.condition.*`. The new row-mode keys went under `engine.inspector.condition.*`, per the triage's namespaces. Moving the two older keys is outside this card.
- Strings drawn by shared children are outside this PR's three files: `InspectorComboField`'s search and empty text, and the `FilterBuilder` inside the filter popover (the packs' `filterBuilder.*`).
- The format sample's value still follows `useDisplayLocale()` (objectui#4575), unchanged. Only its "Sample:" lead-in moved to the catalogue.
- The changeset declares `@object-ui/app-shell: patch` only. The dispatch asked for `@object-ui/i18n` too, but nothing in `packages/i18n` changes (H3).
- PR 2 (`HookDefaultInspector.tsx`, `ActionDefaultInspector.tsx`) completes the card.
